content: Adiponitrile is a chemical compound with the molecular formula (CH2)4(CN)2. Due to its significant industrial importance, various synthetic methods have been developed for its production. One such method involves the dimerization of acrylonitrile through an electrosynthesis process. Another approach utilizes the nickel-catalyzed hydrocyanation of butadiene to produce adiponitrile. Furthermore, adiponitrile can undergo hydrogenation to yield 1,6-diaminohexane or hydrolysis to produce adipic acid.
